description: With 'Automatically save the document instead' enabled, recovery after a crash shows a chain of error dialogs.
expected_report: Options set to autosave the document itself; the user types, waits for autosave, kills soffice.bin, then starts LibreOffice again. Instead of opening the document, a chain of dialogs appears: document recovery, 'The file '' is corrupt', repair error, 'original document recovered', 'recovery was interrupted'; after that the file opens fine. Expected: the autosaved document opens without dialogs. Regression since 25.8.
difficulty: Long (109 s), settings dialog plus Task Manager/process kill, a chain of modal dialogs to read in order.
